title: Lockup with a stepping word wheel
summary: A fixed logo lockup sits beside a tall vertical list of one-word features; the list steps up one slot per second and only the word level with the lockup is dark. Twenty steps make a seamless 20 s loop.
use_when: A product with many features or product lines that each fit in one word
A looping brand background for a booth screen, story or site hero
A calm, confident fintech or utility brand voice with no UI to show
Silent autoplay where the lockup must stay readable the whole time

look.type_style: lockup: round black mark + bold grotesk wordmark, sentence case, ~2.6 % H; list: regular grotesk, sentence case, same size, row pitch ~5.3 % H; active word dark, neighbours fade by distance

sfx.event: list settles on the next word (once per second)

structure.shot: lockup (mark + wordmark) centred-left; to its right a tall list of one-word features, the first one dark, the rest pale
structure.camera: locked-off frame, no scale or pan; only the list moves inside it
structure.motion: no entrance, the film opens mid-loop on word 1; first step starts at f12 (0.40 s): list rises one row on easings.inOutSine 6 fr (30 fps strip, ±1 fr), lands f18 (0.60 s)

structure.shot: 20 list steps merged into one row (avg 0.98 s, 19.60 s total each): the list rises one row per second, each new word turns dark beside the fixed lockup
structure.camera: locked-off frame; lockup fixed, list travels one row pitch (~5.3 % H) per 30 fr
structure.motion: every second: step starts at x.40 s, easings.inOutSine 6 fr (measured on a 30 fps strip at 1.00-2.00 s, ±1 fr), hold 24 fr; active word darkens and the previous one greys during the same 6 fr; the 20th step (19.40-19.60 s) lands on word 1 again

params.brand: any brand.json: mark + wordmark for the lockup, bg, fg for the active word, muted for the list
params.content.words: 8-24 one-word features or product lines (reference: 20); the loop length is words x period
params.timing.period: frames per step at 30 fps (default 30); hold = period - move
params.timing.move: frames of the step move (default 6, easings.inOutSine)
params.falloff: opacity of rows by distance from the active row (default 1, 0.45, 0.3, then down to 0.08 at the edges)
params.aspect: 9:16 | 4:5 | 1:1 | 16:9; list height fills the frame, lockup stays at vertical centre
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); timing scales with it

notes: Measured on a 30 fps strip at 1.00-2.00 s: one step per 30 fr, move 6 fr slow-in slow-out (inOutSine, ±1 fr), hold 24 fr; steps start at x.40 s. 20 words, so frame 600 equals frame 0: perfect loop. The lockup never moves. Row pitch ~5.3 % of H, about 19 rows visible. Beat: the lockup is constant, the changing words are the content, so rows after the hook are feature, not logo. Proposed term focus-wheel (flat vertical list stepping one slot with opacity falloff by distance) is not in the vocabulary; word-swap + stacked-roll are the nearest ids. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (the reference is silent).
